character_types: bearded warrior in lamellar armor and conical helmet
visual_synopsis: On a bare red volcanic hillside a dark-haired woman in a white blouse is chained by the wrists to the rocks while a bearded warrior in red lamellar armor and a conical blue helmet rides up, dismounts and trades long shouted close-up speeches with her, intercut with blurry zooms onto a shaggy-haired youth wearing an eyepatch. At the end the man in red grapples with the woman against the rock face beside the discarded helmet and spear. The material looks like clips from a historical costume film rather than a studio-shot sketch, so the joke is almost certainly in the dialogue.
